# EcclesiaOS v1.0.50

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.50 makes configured email providers available globally for password recovery and application notifications.

## Email delivery

- Password reset mail now uses the enabled church email provider, with a global enabled-provider fallback.
- Application email delivery uses the same provider fallback behavior.
- Added SMTP-backed password-reset verification coverage.
- Updated the recovery page guidance so it points administrators to Communication Integrations when delivery is not configured.

## Verification

- Password reset and communication reliability tests pass.
- Blade templates compile successfully and code formatting passes.
